visualMaster.rule: Do not infer page-specific geometry, module bundling or styling from prose. Review the actual user-provided page image and complete both visual-review passes before locking.

requiredAfterVisualReview: constraintLevel and tolerance per major object
photo masks, face-safe zones and replaceability

passBChecks: which fixed title/badge/icon groups are one bundled display object
whether any photo proxy contains page decoration
reviewProcess.lockCondition: Do not set VISUAL_MASTER_LOCKED until both passes are complete and all findings plus display-module/proxy classifications are corrected in this manifest.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Classify fixed short CLOSING / THANK YOU title systems, short fixed badges, page labels and fixed decorative phrases with their backgrounds/icons as complete generated display modules when the Visual Master treats them as one object. Visible fixed text need not remain editable. Long closing-message body copy, names/signatures if not explicitly fixed, and personal/TBD copy remain separate/native until approved.

photoPolicy.rule: Every real-photo slot must be a separate clipped/masked replaceable image. Use only clean standalone real/representative photos with no P07 closing title, message paper, badge, flower, border or page decoration baked into the proxy. Face/eye safety overrides TARGET geometry.

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P07.png used as a photo fill
page screenshot used as photo proxy
generic editable Figma primitives replacing an authored fixed display module solely for editability
long closing message baked into generated art before copy lock
fixed display module flattening a replaceable real photo

qa.gate0: Pending direct visual review of actual page master plus second-pass reverse omission audit.
